title: Preparing herbs for a cup of tea - Summertime Cottage Vlog
en: it is summertime and that means that the wildflowers will soon be gone during this time i usually harvest what last little bits of flowers i find and also start to focus on my own garden yesterday i made the happy discovery of wild chamomile growing among my marigolds it is also known as pineapple weed and like dandelions it's not necessarily considered a gardener's friend however many of these weeds are actually quite useful and at times beneficial

it simply takes some knowledge of how to forage and use them for example dandelion petals are actually rather sweet and tasty and pineapple weed smells like a more citrusy version of chamomile plus it tastes amazing of course one of my favorite plants for tea making is lavender and i like to harvest and dry it and keep it for the winter months when i am missing spring some lavender keeps its scent longer than others english lavender for example doesn't always smell very strongly however

i find it to be the best for tea making still i like to make a little bundle for drying all i find you have to do is pinch the flowers between your fingers a little bit to release the scent or if i'm gonna make tea i use a mortar lavender tea is one of my absolute favorites i never get tired of it even the busiest days require slow moments
though it's only the start of the summer my herb garden is doing quite well it is very abundant and i am excited to have multiple harvests this year i love the process of tea making it is so calming

and meditative it is definitely a labor of love as you have to harvest quite a lot of leaves to make even one small jar of tea but in my mind it's definitely worth it here are many ways to dry your tea there are many ways to dry your tea leaves over here it's not very humid so i can dry them out in the sun within a day however you can also use a dehydrator which is quite useful for large batches if you are seeking to learn more about

tea making i highly recommend this book i'll leave the link down below it was my first introduction to understanding how to grow and take care of tea plants and it was very inspiring to me here are some of my favorite combinations of tea if you are not already a tea maker i highly recommend experimenting with some simple herbs that are easy to grow like mint it is so wonderful to experience growing a plant and harvesting and consuming it it really keeps you connected to the natural cycle

while i embrace and accept the importance of every season summer is complicated for me while i spend most of it by the lake and love the feeling of the sun tickling my neck i'm always aware of the possibility of wildfires there's evidence of them all over the

county and so many trees have been lost wildfires can occur naturally but many of them are started by accidents or by carelessness my greatest fear is fire since i have some memories associated with it that were highly traumatic but if i ever find myself worrying too much about the unknown i try to stop and remember the spring nature doesn't stop growing just because of the fear of a future that may or may not happen it blooms and thrives and does what it can with the time that it has this is something that
zh: 现在是夏天，这意味着野花很快就会在这段时间消失，我通常会收获我找到的最后一点花，并且开始关注我自己的花园，昨天我很高兴地发现我的万寿菊中生长着野生洋甘菊，它也被称为菠萝草，像蒲公英一样，它不一定被认为是园丁的朋友，但其中许多杂草实际上非常有用，有时甚至是有益的
它只需要一些如何采集和使用它们的知识，例如蒲公英花瓣实际上相当香甜可口，菠萝草闻起来像洋甘菊的柑橘味版本，而且它的味道令人惊叹，当然我最喜欢的泡茶植物之一是薰衣草，我喜欢收割并干燥它并在我想念春天的冬天保存它一些薰衣草比其他薰衣草保持香味更长时间例如英国薰衣草并不总是闻起来很浓烈
我发现它是泡茶的最佳选择，但我喜欢制作一小束来干燥，我发现你所要做的就是在手指之间捏一下花，以释放香味，或者如果我要泡茶，我会使用研钵薰衣草茶是我绝对的最爱之一，我永远不会厌倦它，即使是最忙碌的日子也需要缓慢的时刻
虽然这只是夏天的开始，但我的药草园长得很好，非常丰富，我很高兴今年能有多次收获，我喜欢泡茶的过程，它是如此平静
和冥想这绝对是一种爱的劳动，因为你必须收获相当多的叶子才能制作一小罐茶，但在我看来，这绝对是值得的，这里有很多方法可以干燥你的茶叶，这里有很多方法可以干燥你的茶叶，这里不是很潮湿，所以我可以在一天内将它们在阳光下晒干，但是你也可以使用脱水机，如果你想了解更多信息，这对于大批量来说非常有用
泡茶 我强烈推荐这本书，我将在下面留下链接，这是我第一次了解如何种植和照顾茶树，这对我来说非常有启发，如果你还不是泡茶者，这里是我最喜欢的一些茶组合，我强烈建议尝试一些简单的草药，这些草药很容易生长，比如薄荷，体验种植植物、收获和食用它真是太棒了，它真的让你与自然循环保持联系
虽然我拥抱并接受每个季节的重要性，夏天对我来说很复杂，而我大部分时间都在湖边度过，喜欢阳光拂过我脖子的感觉，但我总是意识到发生野火的可能性，到处都有证据表明发生野火。
县里有很多树木被烧毁，野火可能是自然发生的，但其中许多是由意外或粗心引起的，我最大的恐惧是火灾，因为我有一些与火灾相关的记忆，这些记忆给我带来了极大的创伤，但如果我发现自己太多地担心未知的事情，我会尝试停下来并记住，春天的大自然不会仅仅因为担心可能发生或可能不会发生的未来而停止生长，它会绽放、蓬勃发展，并在它拥有的时间里尽其所能，这是这样的事情
